_source: Single-axis ball-screw linear rail on one A6-EC drive. Design 2026-10-12 mechanics, migrated 2026-10-19 to linear absolute mode with software ratio 100/1, continuous counts and exact multi-turn evidence. Every motion number remains an unverified design value.
max_cycle_lateness_ns_unverified: Native conservative 1 ms deadline (as a Rosie 1430 arm); not a measured qualification of this host.
drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm_unverified: Drive 0x607F cap = limits.max_velocity: 1.5707963 rad/s x 100 x 60 / (2*pi) = 1500 motor rpm = 250 mm/s at 10 mm lead. Unverified: check the screw's critical speed and DN rating for the installed length before raising it.
_drive_supervision_source: Copied from a Rosie 1430 arm's machine configuration: enable_timeout_ms 500 and release_slack_ms 500; disarm_motion_tolerance = limits.following_error, 1 mm = 0.0062832 rad (13107 counts at 100:1). Unverified on this rail.
_tracking_lag_allowance_source: Same as a Rosie 1430 arm: an A6-EC with factory speed feedforward off (C01.13/C01.14 = 0/0, C01.00 = 40 rad/s) trails its command by ~27 ms (a Rosie 1430 arm's stop dumps 2026-10-06), so the 1 mm static following error would fault at ~37 mm/s. Bound = static + |commanded velocity| x 50 ms: 1 + 12.5 = 13.5 mm at 250 mm/s. Unverified on this rail: measure its lag.

robot_description.source: Single-axis rail design 2026-10-12; recompute with robot_description/go/cmd/identity after any edit to the description.

axes.slave_position_unverified: Placeholder: zero-based EtherCAT position of the rail drive; read it from the bus (ethercat slaves) on the servo host.
axes.limits_unverified: Design values converted at 159.155 mm/rad, unverified until measured on the installed rail: travel 5..995 mm (0.031416..6.251769 rad, the robot definition bound); max_velocity 250 mm/s (1.5707963 rad/s, 1500 motor rpm); jog_acceleration 500 mm/s^2 (3.1415927 rad/s^2, reaches 250 mm/s in 0.5 s over 62.5 mm); max_target_lead 0.5 mm (warning); following_error 1 mm (fault, 100 ms persistence, plus tracking_lag_allowance); completion_tolerance 0.05 mm within 1000 ms (a Rosie 1430 arm's timeouts).

collision_watchdog._source: Example design 2026-10-12: following-error trip just under the 1 mm static following_error (12000 counts = 0.92 mm at 13107.2 counts/mm), 10 consecutive cycles; torque 500 raw (50.0 percent rated) is the mini bench placeholder (rt-core/config/machines/bench/one-motor-1to1.json).
collision_watchdog._unverified: unverified placeholders. The watchdog compares the drive's 0x60F4 following error against this static count with no tracking_lag_allowance and trips on torque OR following error: at the ~27 ms A6-EC lag (feedforward off) 12000 counts is reached at ~34 mm/s. Raise it toward the speed-scaled bound (13.5 mm = 176947 counts at 250 mm/s) or measure the lag before running faster. Torque: measure the rail's acceleration and friction torque, then set a margin above it.

runtime_unverified: Placeholder CPU0/FIFO80 (as a Rosie 1430 arm); qualify scheduler admission, isolation and cycle latency on the servo host.
_bus_bringup_source: Same as a Rosie 1430 arm: A6-EC fixed PDO preset (required by a6ec_sdo coordinate evidence), output watchdog and distributed clocks enabled.
